headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 9, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game, with Gerrit Cole leading the way on the mound. Cole pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs. In other action, the Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Gage Jump leading the way on the mound. Jump pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 11 batters while allowing 2 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Griffin Jax, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays due to right elbow discomfort. Other players on the injured list include Cooper Pratt (Milwaukee Brewers), Jack Leiter (Texas Rangers), Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays), Cole Wilcox (Seattle Mariners), Joe Ryan (Minnesota Twins), Slade Cecconi (Cleveland Guardians), and Chris Murphy (Chicago White Sox).

The Miami Marlins made several notable trades, including sending 1B Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals and acquiring RHP Brandan Bidois from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game. Gerrit Cole led the Yankees to victory with a strong 7.0 innings pitched performance, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Gage Jump leading the way on the mound. Jump pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 11 batters while allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Out Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, handing the Reds a tough loss. Impact hitters for the Nationals included Abimelec Ortiz, Daylen Lile, Jorbit Vivas, and Keibert Ruiz.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, taking the game 4-3. Key contributors for the Athletics included Henry Bolte and Eli White, who made significant impacts in the contest.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Griffin Jax Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have added first baseman Jacob Berry to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being dealt to the team.
